summary: Validated (validate --run <run> --submission update15.json → valid=true). New A2 lead on the evidence the transfer path uses to call a target ready. The per-target condition before TimeoutNow is a single catch-up loop over followerReplication.nextIndex (raft.go:989-1012), and the automatic target choice compares the same field — which the retained test fixes as the comparator by injecting cursor values, including one above the leader's last index (raft_test.go:2364-2401). That cursor is created optimistically as the leader's own last index plus one whenever replication state is built (raft.go:597-610) and is lowered only when a peer *rejects* an AppendEntries; a transport error just increments the failure counter and returns (replication.go:229-235). So a peer unreachable since that initialization satisfies the readiness loop with no successful exchange at all. Recorded as one Fact plus a conditional interpretation: the transfer can be initiated toward a possibly-behind peer; because the induced candidacy is transfer-marked, voters do not apply the known-leader rejection but still apply the log comparison, so a genuinely behind target does not win while the incumbent adopts the higher term and leaves its leader loop — and the caller's future still resolves as success on that branch (the mis-association recorded earlier, now shown to be reachable for a voting target, not only a non-voting one). Counterevidence kept prominent: the cursor is corrected by the peer's first response of any kind (so the window is one round trip after the peer becomes reachable), a current target transfers normally, the documented contract tells callers to consult Leader()/LeaderWithID(), and the pickServer test fixes only the comparator, asserting neither freshness nor the uncorroborated case. Discriminator stated for a later run: elect a leader while one voter is unreachable, then call LeadershipTransferToServer for that voter immediately on its return and observe TimeoutNow being sent before any successful AppendEntries response from it.
